block.title: the discharge wave in ultra slow bloom

block.notes: "Rolling outward wave of arcs" instead of "lightning bolt" keeps it a discharge front, not a weather event. The hold-to-white then fade-to-cleared-field is a built-in scene transition — reuse the tail as an incoming card for any aftermath shot.
